label: Midday Update
headline: S&P +1.0% at 11:30, Nasdaq +1.8%, payrolls +165K vs 65K, 2y 4.52%, Dec hike odds ~80%
stance: The chip bounce is holding into lunch and the beat put the December hike back near 80%. Thursday's 2y rally is the casualty, not the equity book.

trigger.detail: S&P 7,429, +1.0% vs Thursday's close at 11:34; VIX 24.9, -12%

scorecard.call: Bounce starts in chips; payrolls decides whether the 2y rally holds. Consensus +59-65K, 4.2%.
scorecard.actual: Right on chips: Nvidia +6.6%, Micron +9.8% at the open. Wrong on the 2y: +165K, 4.1%, 2y 4.52% by 8:35

scorecard.call: A print above 80K is the test for the 5y longs, 99th %ile.
scorecard.actual: Failed: +165K plus +84K of revisions. 2y +5bp, 10y 4.88% at 8:35; 10y back to 4.85% at 11:19

scorecard.call: UMich prelim 10:00: first household inflation read since Brent fell 12%.
scorecard.actual: 51.0 vs 48.0 at 10:00; 1y expectations 4.3% from 4.7%. Survey closed before the election

bullets: Open: Nasdaq +1.8%, S&P +1.0%, Dow -0.2% at 10:00. Tech +2.7%, staples -1.5%. Rotation back into Thursday's losers.
Payrolls +165K vs 65K at 8:30, unemployment 4.1%, hourly earnings +0.4% m/m. Dec hike odds ~80% by 9:00, from ~70% overnight.
2y 4.52%, +5bp at 8:35; 10y 4.85%, +1bp at 11:19. The front end paid for the beat.
Dollar 102.19, +0.6% at 11:24. USD/CAD 1.412 after Canada lost 4.7K jobs, unemployment 6.7% at 8:30.
Afternoon: Bowman 12:15. A close above Thursday's close on heavy volume is the bar.

items.head: Humana +4% on a narrower loss, 2026 EPS guide to $9.50+
items.body: Q3 adj. loss $0.70 vs -$1.00 consensus; revenue $41.2bn vs $40.9bn. Benefit ratio 93.7% vs 94%+ guided. $428 at 10:37.

items.head: Charter: pro forma revenue -1.5%, EBITDA -3%
items.body: Internet customers 29.2mn, -1.9% y/y. Targets $1bn Cox synergies plus $2bn cost savings in 18 months.

watch.head: Bowman 12:15
watch.body: First Fed voice after the beat. December is ~80%; the question is January, priced ~20% Thursday.

watch.head: Consumer credit 3:00
watch.body: September household borrowing. UMich: 57% cite eroded living standards, highest since May.

watch.head: Close: does Nasdaq hold Thursday's low
watch.body: Rebalance flow flips to buying on an up day; watch the last 30 minutes.

watch.head: Hormuz over the weekend
watch.body: Trump weighing resumed strikes on Iran vs a deal, per Axios Friday. Brent $97.81, -0.5% at 11:24.
